findings.finding: Performers adjust their aiming behavior between trials to find a safe yet fast execution zone.
findings.quote: how performers adjust their trial-to-trial aiming behavior to find a safe, but fast, zone for movement execution.

findings.finding: Mental practice improves motor performance and transfers partially to other workspaces.
findings.quote: mental training facilitates motor learning and allows its partial transfer to nearby workspaces.

findings.finding: A single bout of moderate aerobic exercise immediately before learning improves motor skill acquisition and accuracy.
findings.quote: moderate intensity running led to an immediate improvement in motor acquisition for both a single session and on multiple sessions across subsequent days

principle: Learners adjust movement speed and accuracy to find a safe and effective zone, and this learning process can be primed by prior physical activity or mental practice.
for_the_teacher: Invite learners to try a short bout of aerobic movement or a warm-up before tackling a new motor skill to prime acquisition.
